arguments.prompt: Wide shot at dusk. The finished long timber rally stage with its row of folding chairs, a podium and a tall rear truss stands empty in the square in front of City Hall, whose windows are lit warm tungsten; the mauve banner hangs on the portico. The camera is locked off on a tripod and does not move at all: no pan, no tilt, no zoom, no drift, no handheld shake. Real-time speed, natural human movement, never slow motion. Almost nothing moves: the sky deepens very slightly toward night, one last pedestrian crosses far off with their back to the camera and is gone, a parked car's tail-lights blink once as it locks. Every vehicle stays parked; the bus at the corner is stopped with its interior lit. No vehicle drives anywhere. Deep blue winter twilight, absolute stillness. Prestige political drama photographed on an Arri Alexa with anamorphic lenses: single-source natural light, slight 35mm film grain, colours desaturated about twelve percent, warm tungstens, deep browns and charcoals in the shadows, photographic realism.
